metadata.question: Was the total rainfall in Grafton, New South Wales, greater than the total rainfall in Canberra from January 15, 2020 to January 21, 2020?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use CHIRPS Daily precipitation (UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY) for 2020-01-15 to 2020-01-22 (end-exclusive) over buffered points for Grafton, NSW and Canberra, ACT. If empty, fallback to ERA5-Land hourly (ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY) summing total_precipitation and converting to mm.
2. Masking strategy: Precipitation products are analysis-ready; no cloud masking required.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: 
   - If both collections empty -> C1. 
   - If any location’s valid pixel count is 0 -> C2.
   - If any computed total is null/NaN or negative -> C3.
   - Otherwise compare totals: Grafton > Canberra => A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helper to await evaluate/getInfo
  const getInfo = (eeObj) =>
    new Promise((resolve, reject) => eeObj.getInfo(resolve, reject));

  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const start = '2020-01-15';
    const end = '2020-01-22'; // end-exclusive to include Jan 21
    const scale = 5500;

    // Locations (lon, lat)
    const graftonPt = ee.Geometry.Point([152.934, -29.691]); // Grafton, NSW
    const canberraPt = ee.Geometry.Point([149.130, -35.281]); // Canberra, ACT
    const bufDist = 10000; // 10 km buffer
    const grafton = graftonPt.buffer(bufDist);
    const canberra = canberraPt.buffer(bufDist);
    const regionUnion = grafton.union(canberra);

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    let datasetUsed = '';
    let sumImg = null;

    // Primary: CHIRPS Daily (mm/day)
    let chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY')
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filterBounds(regionUnion)
      .select('precipitation');

    const chirpsSize = await getInfo(chirps.size());
    if (chirpsSize && chirpsSize > 0) {
      datasetUsed = `CHIRPS Daily`;
      sumImg = chirps.sum().rename('precipitation'); // mm over period
    } else {
      // Fallback: ERA5-Land Hourly total_precipitation (meters per hour); convert to mm
      let era = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(regionUnion)
        .select('total_precipitation');
      const eraSize = await getInfo(era.size());
      if (!eraSize || eraSize === 0) {
        console.log(`CHIRPS Images: ${chirpsSize || 0}`);
        console.log(`ERA5-Land Hourly Images: ${eraSize || 0}`);
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
      datasetUsed = `ERA5-Land Hourly (sum, mm)`;
      sumImg = era.sum().multiply(1000).rename('precipitation'); // meters -> mm
      console.log(`CHIRPS Images: 0`);
      console.log(`ERA5-Land Hourly Images: ${eraSize}`);
    }

    if (datasetUsed === 'CHIRPS Daily') {
      console.log(`CHIRPS Images: ${chirpsSize}`);
    }
    console.log(`Dataset Used: ${datasetUsed}`);

    // 3. Processing and pixel validation
    const countReducer = ee.Reducer.count();
    const meanReducer = ee.Reducer.mean();

    const gCount = await getInfo(
      sumImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: countReducer,
        geometry: grafton,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      }).get('precipitation')
    );
    const cCount = await getInfo(
      sumImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: countReducer,
        geometry: canberra,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      }).get('precipitation')
    );

    if (!gCount || !cCount || gCount === 0 || cCount === 0) {
      console.log(`Grafton Pixels: ${gCount || 0}, Canberra Pixels: ${cCount || 0}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation
    const gTotal = await getInfo(
      sumImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: meanReducer,
        geometry: grafton,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      }).get('precipitation')
    );
    const cTotal = await getInfo(
      sumImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: meanReducer,
        geometry: canberra,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      }).get('precipitation')
    );

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    const invalid =
      gTotal === null || cTotal === null || isNaN(gTotal) || isNaN(cTotal) || gTotal < 0 || cTotal < 0;
    if (invalid) {
      console.log(
        `Values invalid -> Grafton: ${gTotal}, Canberra: ${cTotal}`
      );
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`Grafton Total (mm): ${gTotal.toFixed(2)} | Pixels: ${gCount}`);
    console.log(`Canberra Total (mm): ${cTotal.toFixed(2)} | Pixels: ${cCount}`);
    console.log(`Difference (Grafton - Canberra, mm): ${(gTotal - cTotal).toFixed(2)}`);

    if (gTotal > cTotal) {
      console.log('A: Yes');
    } else {
      console.log('B: No');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
